Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged?…

translations.web: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
translations.bsb: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
translations.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
translations.asv: And if any man would go to law with thee, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
